questions.question: The proportion of a small increase in income which will lead to increased consumption expenditure is known as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **marginal propensity to consume.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In economics, **marginal propensity to consume (MPC) **is defined as the proportion of a cumulative increase in wages that a consumer spends on the consumption of goods and services, as opposed to saving.
 
• Marginal propensity to consume is **a component of Keynesian macroeconomic theory** and is calculated as the change in consumption divided by the change in income.
 
• The MPC is represented **by a consumption curve,** which is a sloping line showing changes in consumption on the vertical "Y" axis and changes in income on the horizontal "X" axis.

 MPS varies by income level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **The principle of "marginal consumption efficiency" **was introduced by John Maynard Keynes, and explained as "the rate of discount which equals the present value of a series of annuities given by the expected return from a capital asset over its time period". Is. Its supply is equal to the price.
 
• **Marginal consumption efficiency (MEC) **is the discount rate that equates the price of a fixed capital asset to its present discounted value of expected income.
 
• **Marginal consumption savings (MPS)** refers to the proportion of the total increase in income that a consumer saves rather than spends on the consumption of goods and services.

**Hence The proportion of a small increase in income which will lead to increased consumption expenditure is known as marginal propensity to consume. **

questions.question: How many seats were reserved for the Scheduled Tribes in Lok Sabha for the 2019 general election?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __47__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the order issued by the** Delimitation Commission in 2008**, **412 are general, 84 seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes, and 47 seats for the Scheduled Tribes.**
 
• For the 15th Lok Sabha elections, the number of seats reserved for scheduled tribes increased from **41 to 47.**
 
• Reservation in India is all about **reserving access to seats in government jobs, educational institutions, and even legislatures to certain sections of the population**.
 
• Also known as affirmative action, the reservation can also be seen as** positive discrimination**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 334** of the Constitution lays down the provisions of the Constitution **relating to the reservation of seats for the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes.**
 
• All voters, **including Non-SC, and Non-ST community voters**, have the **right to vote for these candidates belonging to SC or ST candidates** if contesting from their constituency.** About 25% of the Indian population belongs to SC/ST communities.**
 
• **About the same ratio of seats are reserved for them in the Parliament.**

questions.question: Which of the following mountains was formed when molten rock from the depths of the earth rose from the crust and piled up on its own?
questions.solution:
Correct answer is __**Mount Kilimanjaro in Africa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mount Kilimanjaro is the African continent's highest peak at 5,895 meters (19,340 feet). The majestic mountain is a snow-capped volcano.**
 
• **Located in Tanzania**, Mount Kilimanjaro is Africa's tallest mountain at about **5,895 meters (19,340 feet).**
 
• Mount Kilimanjaro **formed as a result of active continental rifting** and is comprised of three volcanic cones.
 
• Volcanic activity is thought to have commenced **around 1 million years ago when molten lava began to burst through fractures created by the progressively thinning lithosphere.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3ee256cdfba8ccbb5adb75fbfc098e2b3ccba142682a491f02b7cc350611f7b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Rocky Mountains formed 80 million to 55 million years ago during the Laramide orogeny**, in which a number of plates began sliding underneath the North American plate.
 
• The **Urals are among the world's oldest existing mountain ranges,** having been formed **about 275 million years ago** due to the collision of the Laurussia supercontinent with the** continent of Kazakhstania**.
 
• **The Alps in Europe _The mountains were formed over tens of millions of years as the African and Eurasian tectonic plates collided**. Extreme shortening caused by the event resulted in marine sedimentary rocks rising by **thrusting and folding into high mountain peaks such as Mont Blanc and the Matterhorn.**
